title: Refactor Emacs modal editing from Evil to Meow

notes: Created `lisp/suderman-meow.el` with owned Meow leader map reset helper, upstream QWERTY normal/motion setup, system clipboard mode, studium-style p/P paste helpers, C-r redo, and mode initial-state list.

description: Replace Evil require and delete old Evil module
details: Precondition proof: run `rg -n "suderman-evil|evil-|evil\\b|general" init.el lisp` before removing anything. Expected current consumers are `init.el`, `lisp/suderman-evil.el`, `lisp/suderman-keys.el`, `lisp/suderman-files.el`, `lisp/suderman-markdown.el`, and `lisp/suderman-reload.el`. Update every consumer to Meow or plain Emacs first, then remove `lisp/suderman-evil.el`. Verification gate: run `test ! -e lisp/suderman-evil.el && ! rg -n "suderman-evil|evil-|evil\\b|evil-collection|general" init.el lisp`; expected exit 0 and no grep output. STOP if any active config reference remains.
notes: Updated `init.el` to require `suderman-meow`, removed all active Evil/General references, and deleted `lisp/suderman-evil.el`. Verification grep for `suderman-evil|evil|evil-collection|general` over `init.el lisp` returned no output.

description: Rewrite global keys and SPC leader for Meow
notes: Rewrote `lisp/suderman-keys.el` for Meow: owned SPC leader map, Meow digit args/cheatsheet, `SPC /` project search, Doom-ish available groups, direct M-window bindings, and no bindings on Meow keypad prefixes `x/c/h/m/g`.

description: Drop Treemacs and update file browser config
details: Precondition proof: run `rg -n "treemacs|suderman/treemacs|window-left-or-treemacs" init.el lisp` before removing anything. Expected current consumers are `lisp/suderman-files.el`, `lisp/suderman-pickers.el`, `lisp/suderman-windows.el`, and `lisp/suderman-keys.el`. Replace every consumer with Dirvish/Dired or plain window movement before dropping Treemacs config. Verification gate: run `! rg -n "treemacs|suderman/treemacs|window-left-or-treemacs" init.el lisp`; expected exit 0 and no grep output. STOP if any active config reference remains.
notes: Removed Treemacs config/functions and replaced explorer/file-browser behavior with Dirvish/Dired, including vim-ish h/j/k/l and M-h/j/k/l bindings. Verification grep for Treemacs/window-left-or-treemacs returned no active config references.
Removed Evil markdown local binding and added vanilla `C-c C-p` binding for `suderman/markdown-preview-buffer`; also exposed preview under `SPC t p` tools.

Reworked hot reload for Meow: clears rebuilt modal keys, resets owned Meow leader map, re-enables `meow-global-mode`, and falls back to `user-emacs-directory/init.el` when `user-init-file` is nil. `emacs --batch -l init.el --eval '(suderman/reload-config)'` exits 0.

Verification passed: removal grep returned no output; `emacs --batch -l init.el --eval '(message "loaded")'` exits 0; `emacs --batch -l init.el --eval '(batch-byte-compile)' ...` exits 0 with no warnings. Removed generated `.elc` files after compile.
